rows.en: Move your UK and European market plans forward on the ground.
rows.zh: 让你的英国与欧洲市场行动，在本地真正向前推进。

rows.en: From validating the market and engaging buyers or partners to delivering launches and exhibitions, Venus Bridge gives Chinese companies the local judgement and execution to build credible momentum across the UK and Europe.
rows.zh: 从市场验证、买家与合作方对接，到发布与展会落地，Venus Bridge 为中国企业提供英国与欧洲本地判断与执行，让市场行动形成可信进展。

rows.en: Understanding Chinese headquarters’ goals. UK and European market judgement. One local team carrying the work forward.
rows.zh: 理解中国总部目标，判断英国与欧洲市场，并由一个本地团队持续推进。

rows.zh: 在真实英国与欧洲市场现场完成工作。

rows.zh: 这些代表项目展示实际商业节点，以及 Venus Bridge 经核实的具体职责。

企业通常在这些时候找到我们

rows.en: Useful when the UK or European opportunity has become real.
rows.zh: 当英国或欧洲机会已经从想法变成具体任务。

rows.en: Five situations typically bring Venus Bridge into a project: commercial intent is clear, while the local path, relationships or execution still need structure.
rows.zh: 企业通常在商业意图已经明确，但本地路径、关系推进或执行方式仍需梳理时，引入 Venus Bridge。以下是五种常见情况。

rows.en: Validate the opportunity, understand the local landscape and decide what should happen first.
rows.zh: 验证市场机会、了解本地格局，并判断第一步应该做什么。

rows.en: Build a coordinated programme around a fixed date, before, during and after the event.
rows.zh: 围绕确定日期，统筹活动前、现场及后续跟进。

rows.en: Looking for buyers, distributors or partners
rows.zh: 寻找买家、经销商或合作伙伴

rows.en: Identify relevant organisations, create the right context and coordinate local engagement.
rows.zh: 识别合适对象、建立商务沟通场景，并推进本地对接。

rows.en: Engage the right industry, expert, institutional and content channels where they strengthen the commercial goal.
rows.zh: 在有助于商业目标时，引入行业、专家、机构或内容环境。

rows.en: When the European team has limited capacity
Add UK execution capacity without immediately building every function in-house.
rows.zh: 在不急于自建全部职能的情况下，补充英国本地执行能力。

rows.en: Four types of local action built around market outcomes.
rows.zh: 围绕市场结果，形成四类本地行动。

rows.en: Understand the market landscape and opportunity, and decide where to invest before committing heavily.
rows.zh: 看清市场格局与机会，在大规模投入前决定应该把钱和时间放在哪里。

rows.en: Identify and build the commercial relationships that can move the market forward.
rows.zh: 识别并对接能够推动市场进展的商业关系。

rows.en: Turn a fixed market moment into a coordinated commercial programme.
rows.zh: 把一个固定市场节点变成前后连贯的商务行动。
行业影响力、内容与市场资产

rows.en: Create evidence and content that remain useful for business communication and market development after the event.
rows.zh: 形成在活动之后仍可用于商务沟通和市场推进的证明与内容。

rows.en: UK and European local delivery capability before you build a full local team.
rows.zh: 在自建完整团队之前，先拥有英国与欧洲执行层。

rows.en: We work alongside Chinese headquarters and existing European teams, adding the market coordination, relationship management and execution capacity required around a defined commercial goal.
rows.zh: 我们与中国总部及现有欧洲团队并肩工作，围绕明确的商业目标补充市场协调、关系推进与本地执行能力。
面向英国与欧洲合作方

rows.en: Participate in Chinese-company projects that are genuinely relevant to you.
rows.zh: 参与背景清楚、与你真正相关的中国企业项目。

rows.en: We bring organisations and specialists into projects where the fit is genuine, with a defined scope, bilingual coordination and one project interface.
rows.zh: 我们只在项目与能力真正匹配时邀请机构和专业团队参与，并提供明确范围、双语协调及统一项目接口。
由项目决定需要什么专业能力。

rows.en: Venus Bridge retains commercial and delivery responsibility and brings in specialist capability only where it strengthens the result.
rows.zh: Venus Bridge 保留商务与执行责任，仅在有助于结果时引入相应专业能力。

rows.en: Make the market moment useful before, during and after it happens.
rows.zh: 让一个市场节点在活动前、现场和结束后都产生价值。

rows.en: Define target organisations, priority meetings, the local story and the follow-up plan.
rows.zh: 明确目标机构、重点会面、本地叙事和后续跟进计划。

rows.en: Coordinate the live environment, stakeholder activity and approved market-facing assets.
rows.zh: 统筹现场环境、利益相关方活动及获准使用的市场内容。

rows.en: Organise follow-up, market information, relationships and reusable content while momentum is fresh.
rows.zh: 及时整理商务跟进、市场信息、合作关系与可复用内容。

rows.en: One market objective. One coordinated local delivery path.
rows.zh: 一个市场目标，一条完整的本地推进路径。
这种合作模式如何运作

rows.en: Understanding the needs of Chinese headquarters
The commercial value should continue after the project ends.
rows.zh: 项目结束，商务价值不应随之停止。

rows.en: Where the agreed scope allows, relationships, market information, approved content and project records are organised for the next conversation—not left behind when the event ends.
rows.zh: 在约定范围内，我们会整理合作关系、市场信息、获准使用的内容和项目记录，为下一次商务沟通继续服务。

rows.en: Venus Bridge helps Chinese companies validate, enter and grow in the UK and Europe through local commercial judgement, relevant relationships and integrated execution.
rows.zh: Venus Bridge 帮助中国企业验证、进入并拓展英国与欧洲市场，通过本地商业判断、相关合作关系与一体化执行推动行动落地。

rows.en: Enter and grow in the UK & Europe with local commercial execution.
rows.zh: 以本地商业执行，进入并拓展英国与欧洲市场。

rows.en: Venus Bridge works with Chinese companies when a UK or European opportunity has become real—whether that means validating the market, finding buyers, preparing for an exhibition, launching locally or adding capacity around a lean European team.
rows.zh: 当英国或欧洲机会已经变得具体——无论是验证市场、寻找买家、筹备展会、落地发布，还是为精简欧洲团队补充执行能力——Venus Bridge 都可以在本地推进工作。

rows.en: We help define the right action, coordinate the relevant local relationships and deliver the work on the ground.
rows.zh: 我们帮助确定正确行动、推进相关本地关系，并把工作落实到现场。
沟通英国 / 欧洲计划

rows.en: When the UK or European opportunity needs to move.
rows.zh: 当英国或欧洲机会需要真正开始推进。

rows.en: Decide whether the UK or European opportunity merits investment, where to begin and what to test next.
rows.zh: 判断英国或欧洲机会是否值得投入、从哪里开始，以及下一步需要验证什么。

rows.en: Identify and engage buyers, distributors, channel partners and relevant industry stakeholders.
rows.zh: 识别并对接买家、经销商、渠道伙伴及关键行业利益相关方。

rows.en: Turn a fixed market date into joined-up activity before, during and after the event.
rows.zh: 把确定的市场节点转化为活动前、现场及后续连贯的商务行动。

rows.en: Show up in the right industry, expert, institutional or content environment.
rows.zh: 在合适的行业、专家、机构或内容环境中，让企业真实出现。

rows.en: Give Chinese headquarters or a lean European team a UK coordination and delivery layer.
rows.zh: 为中国总部或精简欧洲团队增加英国本地协调与执行支持。

rows.en: Decide whether the UK or European opportunity merits investment, where to begin and what to test next.
rows.zh: 判断英国或欧洲机会是否值得投入、从哪里开始，以及下一步需要验证什么。

rows.en: Identify and engage buyers, distributors, channel partners and relevant industry stakeholders.
rows.zh: 识别并对接买家、经销商、渠道伙伴及关键行业利益相关方。

rows.en: Turn a fixed market date into joined-up activity before, during and after the event.
rows.zh: 把确定的市场节点转化为活动前、现场及后续连贯的商务行动。

rows.en: Show up in the right industry, expert, institutional or content environment.
rows.zh: 在合适的行业、专家、机构或内容环境中，让企业真实出现。

rows.en: Give Chinese headquarters or a lean European team a UK coordination and delivery layer.
rows.zh: 为中国总部或精简欧洲团队增加英国本地协调与执行支持。

rows.en: Local action assembled around the commercial result.
rows.zh: 围绕商业结果组合本地行动。

rows.en: Market landscape, competitor context, opportunity assessment, stakeholder mapping and a first-action recommendation.
rows.zh: 市场格局、竞争环境、机会判断、相关方梳理与首步行动建议。

rows.en: Decide where to invest before committing heavily.
rows.zh: 在大规模投入前，先决定钱和时间应该放在哪里。

rows.en: Buyer and distributor research, partner identification, business meetings and industry participation.
rows.zh: 买家与经销商研究、合作方识别、商务会面及行业参与。

rows.en: Build local relationships that can move the market forward.
rows.zh: 建立能够推动市场进展的本地关系。

rows.en: Exhibition planning, launches, venues, local teams, on-site coordination and stakeholder coordination.
rows.zh: 展会计划、发布活动、场地、本地团队、现场统筹与利益相关方协调。

rows.en: Turn a market moment into a complete commercial programme.
rows.zh: 把一次市场节点变成完整的商务计划。
行业影响力、内容与市场资产

rows.en: Expert, university or creator engagement where relevant, plus photography, film, interviews and project records.
rows.zh: 在适用时组织专家、高校、创作者、摄影、影片、采访与项目记录。

rows.en: Leave with assets that support sales, communications and follow-up.
rows.zh: 留下可用于销售、传播和后续跟进的资产。

rows.en: Faster action. Less complexity. Stronger local continuity.
rows.zh: 更快行动，更少复杂度，更强本地连续性。

rows.en: Choose the right action for the UK or European context, rather than simply following headquarters instructions mechanically.
rows.zh: 依据英国与欧洲市场语境决定怎么做，而不是机械执行总部指令。

rows.en: Connect the brief, local relationships, timing, approvals and live execution through one team.
rows.zh: 由同一个团队连接商务需求、当地关系、时间、审批与现场执行。

rows.en: Turn the headquarters goal into action that local teams can understand and advance.
rows.zh: 把中国总部目标转化为当地团队可以准确理解并推进的行动。

rows.en: Add the capability the current goal requires without immediately building every function in-house.
rows.zh: 围绕当前任务补齐所需能力，不必立即自建全部职能。

rows.en: Organise relationships, market information, approved content and commercial follow-up while momentum is fresh.
rows.zh: 及时整理关系、市场信息、获准内容和下一步商务跟进。

rows.en: Turn a fixed date into joined-up commercial activity.
rows.zh: 把固定日期变成前后连贯的商务行动。

rows.en: The value of an exhibition is not confined to the stand. It comes from connecting target relationships, on-the-ground market judgement and follow-up.
rows.zh: 展会价值不只在展台当天，而在目标关系、现场判断与后续推进能否连成一条线。

rows.en: Map target buyers, distributors or partners; arrange priority meetings; define the local narrative and follow-up plan.
rows.zh: 梳理目标买家、经销商或合作方；安排重点会面；明确本地叙事与跟进计划。

rows.en: Coordinate on-site delivery, stakeholder engagement and approved material for market communications.
rows.zh: 统筹现场执行、利益相关方互动，以及获准用于市场沟通的内容记录。

rows.en: Organise contacts, market feedback, follow-up material and next actions so the exhibition feeds the commercial pipeline.
rows.zh: 整理联系人、市场反馈、后续材料与下一步行动，让展会真正进入商务管道。

rows.en: Add key execution capability before building a full local team.
rows.zh: 在自建完整团队之前，先补上关键执行能力。

rows.en: Venus Bridge can work alongside headquarters and existing UK or European teams, adding market coordination, partner engagement and execution around a defined goal. University, researcher and talent expertise is brought in selectively for technical credibility, employer branding or industry dialogue.
rows.zh: Venus Bridge 可以与总部和现有英国或欧洲团队并肩工作，围绕明确任务补充市场协调、合作方对接与执行能力。高校、研究人员及人才能力仅在有助于技术可信度、雇主品牌或行业交流时加入。

rows.en: Tell us what needs to happen in the UK or Europe.
rows.zh: 告诉我们，英国或欧洲现在需要发生什么。

rows.en: You do not need a finished brief. Share the market, goal, timing and anything already agreed or in place; we will assess the fit and suggest the most useful next step.
rows.zh: 不需要先准备完整方案。说明市场、目标、时间和已经确定的条件，我们会判断是否匹配并建议下一步。

rows.en: The project goal determines who needs to be involved.
rows.zh: 由项目目标决定谁需要加入。

rows.en: Relevant opportunities, clear scope and smoother cross-border collaboration.
rows.zh: 相关机会、清楚范围和顺畅跨境协作。

rows.zh: 仅在项目与贵方能力、受众或环境真正匹配时发出邀请。

rows.zh: 在沟通参与前说明企业、市场目标与合作相关性。

rows.en: Agree roles, timing, deliverables, approvals and usage before delivery.
rows.zh: 提前确认角色、时间、交付内容、审批与使用方式。

rows.en: Reduce information loss between Chinese companies and UK or European teams.
rows.zh: 减少中国企业与英国、欧洲团队之间的信息损耗。

rows.en: Venus Bridge connects cross-border communication with local delivery.
rows.zh: 由 Venus Bridge 连接跨境沟通与本地执行。

rows.en: When the first project works well and relevance continues, further opportunities can follow naturally.
rows.zh: 首次合作顺利且相关性持续时，再自然推进后续机会。

rows.zh: 如果你代表高校、研究团队、行业机构、专业服务、场地、创意团队或其他本地执行能力，请介绍你们的工作，以及最有价值的合作场景。
